description: This file defines the InfinityEmbeddingConfig class, which provides methods for configuring, validating, transforming requests and responses, and handling errors for Infinity embedding API integration within a larger language model framework.

classes.name: InfinityEmbeddingConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for managing Infinity embedding API interactions, including URL construction, environment validation, parameter mapping, request/response transformation, and error handling.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for InfinityEmbeddingConfig, currently does nothing.

methods.name: get_complete_url
methods.description: Constructs the complete API URL for embeddings, ensuring proper formatting and endpoint inclusion.

methods.name: validate_environment
methods.description: Prepares and returns headers for API requests, including authorization, based on provided headers and secrets.

methods.name: get_supported_openai_params
methods.description: Returns a list of supported OpenAI-like parameters for the Infinity API.

methods.name: map_openai_params
methods.description: Maps OpenAI parameters to Infinity-specific parameters for API requests.

methods.name: transform_embedding_request
methods.description: Transforms input data into the format required for the Infinity embedding API request.

methods.name: transform_embedding_response
methods.description: Processes the raw HTTP response from the API into a structured EmbeddingResponse object, handling JSON parsing and errors.

methods.name: get_error_class
methods.description: Returns an InfinityError exception instance for handling API errors.
